context: A boss reviews his project team roster
purpose: Teach: 小沢/三郎/弘/宏/斉藤/安藤/藤井/次郎

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の主軸、小沢部長、三郎課長で。
lines.en: This quarter's core team: Director Ozawa and Section Chief Saburo.
lines.style: Measured authority. Slight pause between the two names, letting each settle. Crisp closing consonant on 'core.' Eyes moving down the list as he speaks—reading, assigning, moving forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。弘前出張は弘さん、宏志くんが同行します。
lines.en: Understood. Hiroshi and Koji will both go to Hirosaki.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient acknowledgment. Slight lift on 'both' to signal the dual assignment. Quick, businesslike—taking notes mentally. No flourish, just capture and confirm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 斉藤さん、安藤さんは、営業の重鎮として外回り。
lines.en: Saito and Ando—they're our senior salespeople, so they'll handle the outside accounts.
lines.style: Calm delegation. Light emphasis on 'senior' to signal trust and weight. Straightforward, like assigning what's already understood. No doubt in the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 藤井さんは技術担当、次郎さんが新人教育を受け持ちます。
lines.en: Fujii takes the technical side; Jiro will manage the new hire training.
lines.style: Brisk, orderly pairing. Each name lands with clarity. The rhythm suggests matching task to person—deliberate fit. Quick breath between clauses, keeping the energy moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よし、来月から本格稼働だ。
lines.en: Good. Full operation starts next month.
lines.style: Closing nod. Slight downward inflection on 'month'—finality. Warmth underneath the efficiency, satisfaction at a plan coming together. Brief, decisive, done.
